topics.title: BI 3776528 / SSTR4 Agonist, CI PSD — Development Plan (Study 1526-0006 PoM Revision & Path to PoC)

background.text: Ph1 (1526-0001) FPI Jan 2025. Trial 1526-0006 is being revised as a PoM study with 3 arms x 25 patients, US only, due to fMRI vendor feasibility and less variability. Pan-Asian Ph1/DDI delayed 4 months to Aug 2026.
background.quote: The 1526‑0006 trial is currently being revised as a PoM study with 3 arms x 25 patients, which is planned in US only considering fMRI vendor feasibility and less variability.

background.text: Path to PoC has not yet been determined; it will be discussed at IUPC in Feb 2026.
